description: Pinned external skill sources, fetched on demand into external/<name>/ by scripts/sync-external.sh. Each source is pinned to a full commit SHA; an optional sha256 of the source tarball enables download verification.

note.description: Human-readable note about how the lock file is used.

for.description: What this source is used for (informational).

license.description: SPDX license identifier of the source, or NOASSERTION when unknown.

name.description: Source key; the directory name under external/ this source syncs into.

sha.description: Full commit SHA the source is pinned to; used in the archive download URL.

sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 hex digest of the source tarball. When present, scripts/sync-external.sh verifies the download against it before extracting.

title: agentkit external skills lock file
